visualCharacteristics.purpose: a carousel of cards with prev/next buttons and slide indicators

contentPattern.structure: one row per slide; cells: optional image (or icon) and content (eyebrow, heading, text, link/button). A cell holding only a /fragments/ link is replaced by the fragment

usage: Service carousels on small-business pages, feature carousels on loan/checking pages, featured hotels, money tips.
reuseGuidance: Default shows 3 image cards per view. icon-slides-in-box(-2) shows 2 icon slides in one panel; -3 shows 4 centred icon slides; image-beside-text shows one wide slide; centre-card-enlarged enlarges the active centre card.
